sentences.text:
The instant pre-arrest bail application has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioner, who is having apprehension of her arrest in connection with FIR No.891/2023 registered at Police Station Shipra Path, District Jaipur City (South) for the offences under Sections 408 & 420 of IPC.
2.

entities.text: Police Station Shipra Path, District Jaipur City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that accused-petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
He further submits that petitioner is not named in the FIR and allegations of cheating and breach of trust have been levelled against the husband of the petitioner.
The alleged offences are triable by Magistrate and maximum punishment for the same is seven years.
Learned counsel submits that petitioner has already [2024:RJ-JP:2834] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-15839/2023] joined the investigation in terms of the order dated 14.12.2023.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor assisted by learned counsel for the complainant opposes the bail application.
However, learned Public Prosecutor admits that petitioner has joined the investigation.
Learned counsel for the complainant submits that it is evident from the investigation report that money has been transferred in the bank account of the petitioner.

4. Considering the contentions put-forth by the counsel for the petitioner and taking into account the totality of facts and circumstances of the case, especially the fact that petitioner is not named in the FIR and she has already joined the investigation, but without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this court deems it just and proper to allow the anticipatory bail application.
5. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

The S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer, Police Station Shipra Path, District Jaipur City (South) in FIR No.891/2023 is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioner - Neeti Gupta W/o Girraj Prasad Gupta, she shall be released on bail,
provided she furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer of the concerned Police Station on the following conditions:-
(i) that the petitioner shall make herself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when [2024:RJ-JP:2834] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-15839/2023] required;
(ii) that the petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or any police officer, and (iii) that the petitioner shall not leave India without previous permission of the court.

(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J 173-Nirmala Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
